query: SELECT sr.id, sr.reelId, sr.jobId, t.id as tid, t.status, CASE WHEN t.transcript IS NULL THEN 'NULL' WHEN t.transcript = '' THEN 'EMPTY' ELSE CONCAT('HAS_DATA(', LENGTH(t.transcript), ')') END as transcript_status FROM saved_reels sr LEFT JOIN transcriptions t ON t.reelId = sr.reelId;
